name: maize-leaf
purpose: Screen one maize leaf photo for five candidate conditions. It supports inspection and is not a diagnosis.
label: maize_leaf_condition: common_rust, corn_leaf_blight, gray_leaf_spot, healthy, insect_damage (image labels of the public dataset below, not labels from Guatemalan fields)

held_out_metrics.split: Deterministic 70/15/15 by unions of original filename and perceptual image hash; augmentation suffixes stripped before splitting
held_out_metrics.note: Internal metrics of the dataset. Not an external validation in Guatemala; scores are not calibrated probabilities.

limits: Candidate image classification, not a confirmed diagnosis or a measure of crop growth.
Only the five listed classes are supported; other plants and disorders may be misclassified.
A healthy label does not rule out disease or pests elsewhere on the plant or field.
Generic insect damage does not identify the insect species or prove fall armyworm.
No external field validation in Guatemala; background and lighting can affect the result.
Treatment choice requires local diagnosis, crop stage and a reviewed management guide.
